items.reason: Reports routine cleanup batches logging full ID lists at Error level, flooding logs and triggering false alarms.
Reports the global cleanup interval changing from ten minutes to one minute, multiplying database load.
Reports a concurrency race between selecting max-count victims and deleting them that can delete rows now within the retained set. No golden issue describes this retention race.
Reports Error-level logging on the normal cleanup path, producing misleading failure signals and log spam.
